implementation: the owning runtime or protocol document
review: the canonical tracking Issue and acceptance mapping
the complete pushed branch diff for human handoff
staging: the exact target and separately authorized environment owner
production: the separately authorized production release contract

fast: root and regression Go module tests
review: For an authorized branch-only assignment, self-review the complete diff, push the exact commit, verify the remote branch SHA and hand its name and evidence to the human owner; do not create a PR or dispatch Jenkins.
staging: Require a separate exact environment identity and authorization before any Jenkins, Helm or deployment operation.

risk_probes: For model request evidence, compare redacted trace content with a controllable model endpoint across enabled, disabled and failure paths.
For protocol changes, test missing and malformed producer events without fabricating successful calls.
